label: At each accessible world lacking the actual contingents, a being there has power for w obtaining
paraphrase: OPEN (Aristotelian grounding at a non-actual world, Pruss's own direction; analyst formulation): at every world v accessible from w that lacks every concrete being contingent at w, if w is accessible from v and v is not w, then some being existing at v has, at v, a power (PowerFor) for the proposition that w obtains. Pruss ('A combined account', read 2026-11-23, navigation only): 'there is a substance x in w1 which could have initiated a causal chain that could lead to w0 being actual'.
